answer: One palm-vein pattern per identity enters the canyon vault: a scan hashed on-chain, with a 25 POA bond locked 90 days. Each epoch the nebula beacon sends a random 6-digit challenge; a fresh scan must match above 0.95 within 10 minutes. Two misses forfeit half the bond and freeze payouts 3 epochs; duplicates slash both bonds. Forging 100 fakes needs 100 real palms: brokered scans start at 15 POA and double every 50 palms, costing 2,250 POA in scans plus 2,500 POA in bonds. Three verifiers re-run each match. A scarred palm may score below 0.95, so a failed match gets one re-scan in 24 hours.
